name: sc-boilerplate
description: Fullstack boilerplate for SC1.5 tech stack demos

scripts.setup: cd bp-backend && docker compose up -d postgres redis && pnpm install --recursive && pnpm --filter bp-contracts build && pnpm --filter bp-backend migration:run && pnpm --filter bp-backend seed
scripts.build: pnpm --filter bp-contracts build && pnpm --filter bp-backend build && pnpm --filter bp-frontend build
